source: OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API (tourism=zoo, tourism=aquarium, leisure=garden + garden:type=botanical/arboretum), one query per country, via fetch_osm_zoos_and_gardens.py -- see data/README.md
attribution: OpenStreetMap contributors, via the Overpass API -- https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Overpass_API -- ODbL licensed, see data/README.md
note: Coverage reflects OSM mapping density, not just what exists on the ground -- a low count in a region is often under-mapping. Nature centers are NOT included (no clean OSM tag); IMLS's BOT discipline does include them, so US cities may list nature centers that comparable cities elsewhere won't. See fetch_osm_zoos_and_gardens.py.
